command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: create dirs"
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/secure /srv/secure /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d

echo "STEP: create backing file (2G sparse)"
sudo -n truncate -s 2G /var/lib/secure/secure.img
sudo -n chmod 600 /var/lib/secure/secure.img

echo "STEP: generate random keyfile"
sudo -n sh -c 'dd if=/dev/urandom of=/etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key bs=512 count=4 2>/dev/null'
sudo -n chmod 400 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key

echo "STEP: luksFormat"
sudo -n cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --key-file /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key /var/lib/secure/secure.img

echo "STEP: luksOpen"
sudo -n cryptsetup luksOpen --key-file /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key /var/lib/secure/secure.img secure

echo "STEP: mkfs.ext4"
sudo -n mkfs.ext4 -q /dev/mapper/secure

echo "STEP: mount"
sudo -n mount /dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure

echo "STEP: verify mount"
mount | grep /srv/secure
df -h /srv/secure

echo "STEP: write helper script"
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/secure-volume-mount.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/secure/secure.img
KEY=/etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure.key
NAME=secure
MNT=/srv/secure

case "$1" in
  start)
    if [ ! -e /dev/mapper/"$NAME" ]; then
      cryptsetup luksOpen --key-file "$KEY" "$IMG" "$NAME"
    fi
    mkdir -p "$MNT"
    if ! mountpoint -q "$MNT"; then
      mount /dev/mapper/"$NAME" "$MNT"
    fi
    ;;
  stop)
    if mountpoint -q "$MNT"; then
      umount "$MNT"
    fi
    if [ -e /dev/mapper/"$NAME" ]; then
      cryptsetup luksClose "$NAME"
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 {start|stop}" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/secure-volume-mount.sh

echo "STEP: write systemd unit"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/secure-volume.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Unlock and mount encrypted /srv/secure volume
DefaultDependencies=no
Conflicts=umount.target
Before=local-fs.target umount.target
After=systemd-udevd.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/secure-volume-mount.sh start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/secure-volume-mount.sh stop

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF

echo "STEP: enable service"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable secure-volume.service

echo "STEP: sanity re-run via systemctl (idempotency check while already mounted)"
sudo -n systemctl start secure-volume.service
sudo -n systemctl status secure-volume.service --no-pager | head -10

echo "STEP: write a marker file with data to prove persistence across reboot"
echo "secure-data-$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" | sudo -n tee /srv/secure/marker.txt
sudo -n md5sum /srv/secure/marker.txt

echo "DONE"
